name: reels-research
description: Keyless Instagram Reels research for agents: Reel details, timestamped transcripts via local speech-to-text (Parakeet Redux), real video frames, Reel links from web pages, plus a research skill.

interface.shortDescription: Let your agent study Instagram Reels: transcripts, frames, hooks. No login.
interface.longDescription: Read Instagram Reels from their links without a login: author, caption, likes and date, a timestamped transcript of what is said (local speech-to-text with Parakeet Redux, 25 European languages), real video frames for on-screen text and visuals, and Reel links collected from web pages. A research skill plans the work and cites every hook.
defaultPrompt: Break down how these Instagram Reels open: what is said, what is on screen, and the hook type.
